JOIN people AS p
  ON e_sup.People_ID = p.People_ID;

FROM employment e1
JOIN employment e2 ON e1.Company_ID = e2.Company_ID AND e1.People_ID != e2.People_ID
JOIN people p ON e1.People_ID = p.People_ID
WHERE e1.Year_working < e2.Year_working

FROM "people" p
JOIN "employment" e1 ON p."People_ID" = e1."People_ID"

    WHERE e2."Company_ID" = e1."Company_ID"
      AND e2."People_ID" <> e1."People_ID"
      AND e2."Year_working" < e1."Year_working"
);

votes.sql:
SELECT
    p1.Name AS manager_name,
    p2.Name AS report_name,
    c.Name AS company_name,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p1.People_ID) AS aligned_report_count
FROM people p1
JOIN employment e1 ON p1.People_ID = e1.People_ID
JOIN company c ON e1.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
JOIN employment e2 ON e2.Company_ID = e1.Company_ID AND e2.People_ID <> p1.People_ID
JOIN people p2 ON e2.People_ID = p2.People_ID
WHERE p1.Graduation_College = p2.Graduation_College
ORDER BY manager_name, report_name;

WITH Colleague_Pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.People_ID AS Person_ID,
        p1.Name AS Person_Name,
        p2.Name AS Report_Name,
        c.Name AS Company_Name,
        p1.Graduation_College
    FROM people p1
    JOIN employment e1 ON p1.People_ID = e1.People_ID
    JOIN employment e2 ON e1.Company_ID = e2.Company_ID AND e2.People_ID != p1.People_ID
    JOIN people p2 ON e2.People_ID = p2.People_ID
    JOIN company c ON e1.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
    WHERE p1.Graduation_College = p2.Graduation_College
),
Aligned_Reports AS (
    SELECT 
        Person_ID,
        Person_Name,
        Company_Name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Report_Name) AS Total_Aligned_Reports
    FROM Colleague_Pairs
    GROUP BY Person_ID, Person_Name, Company_Name
)
SELECT 
    Person_Name,
    Report_Name,
    Company_Name,
    Total_Aligned_Reports
FROM (
    SELECT 
        cp.Person_Name AS Manager_Name,
        cp.Report_Name,
        cp.Company_Name,
        ar.Total_Aligned_Reports,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cp.Person_ID ORDER BY cp.Report_Name) AS rn
    FROM Colleague_Pairs cp
    JOIN Aligned_Reports ar ON cp.Person_ID = ar.Person_ID
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1 OR (rn > 1 AND Manager_Name IN (SELECT Manager_Name FROM Aligned_Reports))
ORDER BY Manager_Name, Report_Name;

SELECT
    p.Name AS manager_name,
    c.Name AS company_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.Name) AS direct_report_names,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.People_ID) AS report_count
FROM
    people p
JOIN
    employment e_p ON p.People_ID = e_p.People_ID
JOIN
    company c ON e_p.Company_ID = c.Company_ID
JOIN
    people r ON r.Graduation_College = p.Graduation_College AND r.People_ID <> p.People_ID
JOIN
    employment e_r ON r.People_ID = e_r.People_ID AND e_r.Company_ID = e_p.Company_ID
GROUP BY
    p.People_ID, p.Name, c.Name
ORDER BY
    p.Name;

JOIN "people" p ON e."People_ID" = p."People_ID"

SELECT p."Name" AS person_name, c."Name" AS company_name
FROM "employment" e
JOIN "people" p ON e."People_ID" = p."People_ID"
JOIN "company" c ON e."Company_ID" = c."Company_ID";
SELECT p.Name AS person_name, c.Name AS company_name FROM "company" c JOIN "employment" e ON c."Company_ID" = e."Company_ID" JOIN "people" p ON e."People_ID" = p."People_ID"

SELECT p.Name AS Person_Name, co.Name AS Company_Name
FROM (
    SELECT e.Company_ID, e.People_ID, e.Year_working,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY e.Company_ID ORDER BY e.Year_working DESC) AS rnk
    FROM employment e
) r
JOIN people p ON r.People_ID = p.People_ID
JOIN company co ON r.Company_ID = co.Company_ID
WHERE r.rnk = 1;
